data.narrative:
Valar Atomics is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Isaiah P. Taylor, currently valued at $6.0B post-money following $1.0B in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 11 nuclear energy peers: 3 public companies (Oklo, Nano Nuclear Energy, and X-Energy trading under relevant tickers) and 8 private firms, including Helion, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and others in the same sector and valuation tier.

Two valuation methods were applicable. The stage-progression method, anchored to the Series B post-money valuation of $6.0B and applying a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier to subsequent rounds, yields $11.4B. The peer-median approach isolates three same-sector comparables with similar valuation profiles: Helion at $15.5B (Series G), Oklo at $7.0B (public), and X-Energy at $5.6B (public), producing a median implied value of $7.0B across the range of $5.6B to $15.5B.

The triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $6.0B to $13.1B, with a median of $9.2B. This median sits meaningfully above the current post-money valuation, reflecting typical step-up expectations at this stage. Key uncertainties include the substantial valuation dispersion within the peer set ($5.6B to $15.5B spread) and differentiation by stage maturity, with Helion's Series G valuation at the upper bound potentially reflecting later-stage risk reduction not yet applicable to Valar Atomics.
